_: The lookbook's judgments (uiwork/look/lookbook.py builds the page from these and a look review's folder): every place held to the frame of its kind, as the style guide's rule 2 and its place table set them. A verdict is ok (holds beside its target), mid (mixed) or bad (falls off); a target is the frame of its kind. Notes are [p, m or o, text]: what holds, what does not, what would bring it up. Judged by eye at V88 (Nov 4) on the review's phone frames; judge again when a place changes.

kinds.name: the fall
kinds.title: Set pieces
kinds.sets: The finish (glow, darkened edges, grain), depth in layers, a picture painted to the screen's edges.

kinds.name: the lobby
kinds.title: Rooms
kinds.sets: One key light through a door, gold veined through black marble, a calm lit floor. The underground is held to it too.

kinds.name: Lamplight Street in the rain
kinds.title: The city at night
kinds.sets: Sodium light, wet reflections, rain against a dark sky.

kinds.name: the stairs at dusk
kinds.title: The Pit
kinds.sets: A warm sky over the terraces, lit windows and lamps, no gold. The Pit's rooms are held to it too.

places.title: The road at sundown
notes: p
The strongest silhouette in the game: Ilyas and the bike black against the low sun, the trim in gold.
p
High cirrus combed across the sky and dust in the sun's rays give it the fall's depth; the stubble carries texture to the foot.
m
As the light goes the sky above the cirrus thins to one flat band (5% of the picture), kept as the dusk's.

places.title: XI. The Roof
places.sub: Midnight, the top of the tower
notes: p
The searchlights fade softly into the night, and the man in white stands lit in the helicopter's door.
p
The gold drains on the shot: 2.7% of the light before it, 1.4% as it fires, 0.7% after.
m
Beside the fall it is flatter: over the pad the sky is one dark field with a few clouds, and nothing below the roof's edge gives it depth.
o
The city far below the edge, small and lost in the finish's haze, would give it the fall's layers.

places.title: The Fall
places.sub: Down the face of Hallowell Tower, into the Pit
notes: p
The frame set pieces are held to: the tower's face in lit windows, the desert in his head beyond it, the finish's glow and darkened edges.
p
Its dearest frame, timed by turns, is every place's budget for a frame.
m
The dream's open sky stays clean on purpose (8 to 10% of the picture flat), the one clean sky in the game.

places.title: V. The Dining Room
notes: p
Arched windows, the bar's bottles and the hanging lamps: warm, busy and lit as the lobby is.
p
Gold in the brass and the lamp glass, sodium orange in the room's warmth, as the colour script has it.
m
The ceiling over the fight is a dark band; its beams repeat, as built things may.

places.title: VI. The Kitchen
notes: p
The copper hood and the lamps over the range light the fight; plates, tiles and steam make it a working room.
p
A critical's flash no longer bleaches a figure white.

places.title: The Platform
places.sub: The family's stop under the Lantern
notes: p
Crystal lamps in gold cages over a green-tiled wall, the cage lift's light, a calm mosaic floor: the lobby's one key light, underground.
p
Since V88 the siding's bed under the edge is lighter: 1% of the picture flat black, 8% before.
m
The vault above is dark brick; its ribs and the track's sleepers repeat by design.

places.title: VII. The Line
places.sub: Under the city, the family's railway
notes: p
Speed: the wall smears, the crystal lamps flash past and throw their light across the deck, and Ilyas reads on 89 to 90% of his outline.
m
Between the lamps the wall and the vault over the fight are one dark smear, and nothing in the upper half holds the eye.
o
More going by up there (the refuges, cables, the old station's lit platform more often) would give it the lobby's interest.

places.title: VIII. The Deep Station
notes: p
Crystals, brass and the depot's engine in its pit: the station's richest frame.
m
Its crowded fight costs as much to draw as the fall's dearest frame (101% timed by turns); the lizard alone is about 9 ms of it.

places.title: IX. The Lobby
notes: p
The frame rooms are held to: the lift's light through its door, gold veined through black marble, a calm lit floor.
p
Gold is 14% of its light against sodium orange's 10%: the family's rooms are gold.
m
The coffers over the room are a regular gilt grid, as the gilt may be.

places.title: X. The Office
notes: p
The desk lamps lit gold and the window's city as a cool fill: gold 32% of its light against sodium's 26%.
m
Before the fight the coffered ceiling is a dim, empty band over the room.

places.title: I. The Field
places.sub: The farm edge, an hour before midnight
notes: p
Hallowell Tower and its H stand on the skyline and the maize tops catch the moon; the ground runs to the foot (42% black at V73, none now).
m
The top half is dark sky, and the fight stands in cold moonlight at one dark value, with nothing warm near it.
o
A warm light near the fight, the city's glow on low cloud or a lamp on the driver's truck, would bring it nearer Lamplight Street.

places.title: II. The Avenue
places.sub: Into the city, a quarter to midnight
notes: p
Three blocks of lit fronts in a seeded order, sodium lamps and the streaks of speed: the city at night, moving.
m
The sky above the fronts takes a third of the screen with little in it.

places.title: III. The Checkpoint
places.sub: The Tower District, ten to midnight
notes: p
Soft floods through the rain, the burning carrier's orange on the officers, the tower's H behind.
m
The far city between the floods is dim and flat.

places.title: IV. Lamplight Street
places.sub: Outside the Lantern Bistro, five to midnight
notes: p
The frame the city at night is held to: sodium light from the bistro's windows, wet stone giving it back, rain against a dark sky.
p
The diners behind the glass are drawn as the game's own people (since V85).

places.title: Lab: the street
notes: p
Lamplight Street fought free: the same rain, lamps and wet stone.

places.title: Lab: the field
notes: p
Moonlight parts the ground from the sky, and the fight reads (82%).
m
Beside Lamplight Street it is plain: small fighters, an empty sky and cold light only.

places.title: Lab: the hill
notes: p
The hill's pools of light are wider, and the fight reads (87%).
m
The same empty sky and cold ground as the field.

places.title: Lab: the wall
notes: p
The gate's fire warms the wall, the one warm light in the lab's night.
m
The sky over the wall is empty, and the ground at the foot is dark.

places.title: 1. Off the Roof
places.sub: The Sump's roof, the night of the fall
notes: p
The hay is straw now, no longer read as gold (5.3% at V73, none now), lit under the far side's windows.
m
It is night and dark: the roof's boards and the drop below take the lower third at one value.

places.title: The Sump's kitchen
notes: p
The stove's warmth on the jars, the strings of garlic and the table: lived in, lit, and no gold.
m
The rafters over the room are dark.

places.title: 2–3. The back room
notes: p
The lamp's pool reaches the floor and the cot; the garlic and the shelf give the wall its story.
m
Bare plank walls fill the frame at one dim value: beside the stairs at dusk it is quiet and flat.
o
A second light, the door's crack or the stove through the wall, would give the planks a fall of light across them.

places.title: 4–5. The yard by day
notes: p
The sun's soft shafts down the quarry wall and its long shadows; saturation .31 to .32, the Pit by day's aim of .3.
m
The wall fills the top half in one texture, and its grey is far from the dusk's warmth.

places.title: 5. The stair-streets by day
places.sub: The Lane stair and the Shelf stair
notes: p
The stair-streets busy with people, their boards and stands at 12 units, saturation .25 to .30.
m
The far wall takes most of the frame, and at the Lane stair the prow of rock is one big surface.

places.title: 5. The Shelf market
notes: p
The stalls lit under their names (Lamp oil, Rice and salt, Linen) with their lamps.
m
The wall above the market is plain and fills half the screen.

places.title: 5–7. The stairs at dusk
places.sub: Down to the Sump; the toll; Tamm
notes: p
The frame the Pit is held to: a warm sky over the terraces, lit windows and lamps, and no gold (0.2% of the light).
p
The toll and Tamm's fight on the same stair keep it in the action.

places.title: 8. The yard at night
notes: p
The Sump's door and window throw their warm light out over the yard, and the far wall's windows speck the dark.
p
Ilyas reads on 74 to 75% of his outline, and since V88 on 70% on a wide screen too: his scarf has edges.

places.title: 9. Short Hand, the mornings
notes: p
Soft shafts through the morning haze, and Tamm and Ilyas read clearly (90% and more).
m
Cold and grey, saturation .15 to .18: the morning sun over the rim and its warmth do not show.
o
A pale warm sun low over the rim, cooler than the day's, as the style guide's rule 4 has the Pit by day.

places.title: Lab: the ledge
places.sub: The skirmish lab, the city's dusk
notes: p
The city's dusk lies in a warm band under the ledge.
m
Above it the fight plays against a black sky.

script.label: The prologue: one night, an hour before midnight to just past it
Act I, the Pit: the landing to the mornings
